atomic_cutover: One test-support change without an ADR or epoch. CapturingMailer and ReplyToResolverStub move to email/emailtest, RecordingBroadcaster with its tenant-wide privacy assertions to realtime/realtimetest, the cheap Argon2id profile and the DefaultOverride seam to auth/userpass/userpasstest, and the device and staff principal bindings to auth/device/devicetest. Each package is a new owner test-support point, so its rules to its own owner and the test-support/test-support -> owner test-support rules are anchored to candidate-created points (ruleAnchoredToCandidateOnlyPoint) and need no reviewed epoch. test keeps type aliases and package-variable re-exports (EmailMessage, Mailer, CapturingMailer, ReplyToResolverStub, BroadcastCall, RecordingBroadcaster, NewCapturingMailer, NewRecordingBroadcaster, AssertSingleTenantEvent, AssertNoTenantWideStudentIdentity, UseCheapArgon2Params, HashTestPassword), and api/testutil keeps its device helpers, so no consumer suite changes. The audit appender boundary tests and TestTenantIsolation_DataDeletionVisibility move from the test package into the internal suite of database/repositories/audit, which already imports only test and models/audit; the test-only audit event helpers NewAuditAuthEvent, SetAuditEventTenant and AuditEventIdentity lose their only caller and are deleted. The internal-test key test -> database/repositories/audit stays until booking_consistency_audit_test.go moves (slice B). Four keys fall (177 -> 173). No route, status code, error string, table or write owner changes.
